2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

258203|a955ba26.name: Hervdana Saegrund
258203|a955ba26.text: Welcome to our humble home. Rest by the fire if ye need to dry off.

141-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-complete.text: Edwin VanCleef... I know the name well.  To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me.  I'll need further proof before I believe this.
141-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

94499-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-complete.text:
Aye, this is good water, $N. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed prove you're ready for the next stage of your journey.

One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
94499-complete.title: Call of Water

94499-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-progress.text: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
94499-progress.title: Call of Water

94500-accept.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-accept.text:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500-accept.title: Call of Water

94501-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94501-complete.text:
Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed. 

These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
94501-complete.title: Call of Water

94501-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94501-progress.text:
Hello again, $N. Yer looking well. 

What brings you back to me so soon?
94501-progress.title: Call of Water

94502-accept.name: Norric Lochthane
94502-accept.text:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502-accept.title: Call of Water

94502-complete.name: Unknown
94502-complete.text: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
94502-complete.title: Call of Water

94502-progress.name: Unknown
94502-progress.text: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?
94502-progress.title: Call of Water

94503-accept.name: Unknown
94503-accept.text: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503-accept.title: Call of Water

94503-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
94503-complete.text:
Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.

Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
94503-complete.title: Call of Water

94505-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
94505-accept.text:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
94505-accept.title: Call of Water

94505-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94505-complete.text:
Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, $N. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.

Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
94505-complete.title: Call of Water

94505-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94505-progress.text: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.
94505-progress.title: Call of Water

94616-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94616-complete.text: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, $N. I have great faith in your abilities.
94616-complete.title: Water Sapta

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98197-complete.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-complete.text:
Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.

Thank you, $c. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197-complete.title: Spoils of War

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98282-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282-accept.title: Alchemical Hazards
